Most of the harm happens before the patient reaches hospital

60%

of reviewed trauma deaths at Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital were judged preventable (23% definitely, 37% potentially).

44%

of those preventable deaths had delay before reaching hospital as the key failure, the most common cause.

82 min

median ambulance transport time in Greater Accra, past the "golden hour" for trauma care.

Bleeding was the leading cause among the deaths judged definitely preventable. Every minute saved finding, triaging and routing the patient is a life-saving minute.

Noise on the emergency line, dead ends at the hospital door

99.2%

of 1.9 million calls to Ghana's 112 line between January and March 2020 were pranks. Only 15,801 were genuine.

The Fire Service still logged 131,862 prank calls in the first quarter of 2025. Each one ties up a dispatcher while a real patient waits.

"No bed syndrome" has been fatal

  • 3 hrsA hit-and-run victim in Accra died after being turned away from three hospitals for lack of beds.
  • 6–7Hospitals that refused a 70-year-old man in 2018 before he died in his car.
  • 4ICU beds at Tamale Teaching Hospital serving the whole Northern Region. All were full when a referred patient arrived in April 2025.

Mothers face the same race against time

958

women died giving birth in Ghana's health facilities in 2025, about 122 per 100,000 live births.

275

maternal deaths per 100,000 live births nationally (Global Burden of Disease 2023, which counts deaths outside facilities too).

Haemorrhage is the leading cause

Heavy bleeding kills in hours. MediDispatch routes childbirth emergencies to hospitals with an obstetrician, a maternity unit and a blood bank, and alerts them before arrival.

The problemWhat MediDispatch does

The AI can raise the alarm. It can never lower it.

MEWS score

A fixed medical formula from five vital signs. Always calculated. This is the baseline.
+

Local AI

Llama 3.2 3B reads the vitals and the paramedic's notes, such as "pregnant, heavy bleeding", and suggests a severity.
Final = higher of the twoThe AI's suggestion only counts if it is more cautious than MEWS.

If the AI is offline, slow or gives a bad answer, the system uses MEWS alone. In testing, that fallback answered in 0.02 seconds.

  • 2,400real cases: every AI model tested did significantly worse than doctors and often ignored guidelines.Nature Medicine 2024 [23]
  • 76.6%triage accuracy for ChatGPT against an expert panel: wrong about one time in four.Scientific Reports 2024 [24]
  • 4.6%of patients under-triaged by the best model in a 2026 study, judged "not ready for clinical use".JMIR Medical Informatics 2026 [25]
  • 5.4×higher odds of death at a MEWS of 5 or more, yet MEWS alone misses context: it scored only 0.67 (AUROC) in African febrile adults.QJM 2001 [22]; EClinicalMedicine 2024 [26]
MediDispatch GHDecision support for trained paramedics, not a diagnosis.

Why the AI runs on our own server in Ghana

5 wks

It works when the internet doesn't

On 14 March 2024 all four subsea cables linking Ghana to Europe were cut; the NCA estimated about five weeks to restore. A cloud AI would have gone dark. A local one keeps working.

Act 843

Patient data stays in Ghana

The Data Protection Act treats health data as special personal data. On 28 April 2026 Ghana turned down a US$109 million health deal over demands for health data. Nothing here leaves the country.

$250m

It fits the national AI strategy

"We must not only use AI, we must localise AI."

President Mahama, launching the National AI Strategy 2025–2035 and a national AI Computing Centre.

2 GB

It is cheap to run

The model file is 2.02 GB and runs on an ordinary server. No per-use fees, no foreign-currency bills, no vendor lock-in. It can be audited and tested on Ghanaian cases.

MediDispatch GHNCA, Mar 2024 [15]; Semafor [16]; Data Protection Africa [20]; GBC, May 2026 [27]; GNA, Apr 2026 [29]; Hugging Face [19]. Built with Llama.

Built, tested and ready for a pilot

166

automated tests passing, on both SQLite and PostgreSQL 16

  • Full flow tested in a browser: report, claim, triage, hospital alert
  • 400 random cases confirm the AI never lowers severity
  • Encrypted names, phone numbers, locations, vitals and photos
  • Audit log of every record viewed; cannot be edited or deleted
  • Photos deleted automatically after 30 days
  • Works offline for bystanders; reports send when signal returns
  • Role-based access: a paramedic cannot open the admin portal
  • Docker deployment with PostgreSQL, Redis and Nginx

Status: working prototype. It is not yet cleared for clinical use. Clinical sign-off, validation on Ghanaian patients and a security review come next.

MediDispatch GHResults from the project's own test suite and end-to-end browser run, October 2026.

What it takes to put MediDispatch on Ghana's roads

  1. Clinical sign-offReview of first-aid steps, MEWS thresholds and AI rules by the NAS and Ministry of Health clinical leads.
  2. Validate the AITest it on real Ghanaian cases and monitor how often it raises severity.
  3. Regional pilotRun alongside NAS dispatch in one region, with verified hospital and bed data.
  4. Reach everyoneAdd SMS and USSD reporting for the quarter of Ghanaians who are not online.
  5. Secure and registerIndependent security review and registration with the Data Protection Commission.
Our ask

A pilot partnership with the National Ambulance Service and the Ghana Health Service, to test MediDispatch in one region.
